title: Resentment is poison
src: Nietzsche, On the Genealogy of Morality, First Essay
idea: Nietzsche saw resentment as a grudge that feeds on itself. It hurts the one who carries it far more than its target.
apply: When you replay a grievance, ask what action would actually change it. Do that, or let it go.
remind: A grudge costs you more than them.
who: Jules, who has not spoken to a former business partner in two years.

items.x: Partner left with the client list

scenes.nar: Two years ago, Jules's business partner left with the client list. Jules has not spoken to him since, and replays it almost every day.
The partner has moved on. Jules is the one paying, with bad sleep, bitter conversations, and energy spent on the past.

items.x: Act: one clear email about what is owed

scenes.nar: Nietzsche saw resentment as poison swallowed by the one who holds it. Jules picks one of two honest options: act, or release. No more rehearsing.
Jules sends one firm email and receives a partial payment. The replaying stops, and the energy goes into winning new clients.
